title: The Greatest Works of Literature of the Age A Frankfurtian Reading of Google, Wikipedia, TikTok, and ChatGPT
creator: Johannes Sigil
description:
A critical essay by Johannes Sigil reading Google, Wikipedia, TikTok, and ChatGPT as the dominant literary forms of the platform age.

Rather than applying literary criticism to content circulating on platforms, the essay treats ranking, consensus procedure, short-form recurrence, and dialogue interfaces as forms in their own right. Drawing on Frankfurt School and adjacent critical traditions, it assigns each platform a genre, poetics, ideology, extraction model, and critical reading practice. The essay’s polemical claim is that these systems organize symbolic experience at a scale once associated with epic, scripture, encyclopedia, lyric, and dialogue—and therefore demand criticism as literature.
